DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: そのぬいぐるみは拾われた物ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is that a stuffed toy you found?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。写真をネットに載せたら、持ち主だという人が今から取りに来るそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 投稿を見た持ち主候補が来ると知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I posted a photo online, and someone who says they own it says they are coming to collect it now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that a possible owner who saw your post is coming. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まだお手元にあるのですね。ご自身で相手へ渡す前に、事務所へお預けください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: You still have it with you, correct? Please leave it at the office before handing it to the person yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。写真に特徴を全部載せたので、見た人なら誰でも同じ説明ができてしまいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 公開した特徴だけでは照合できないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. I included all its identifying details in the photo, so anyone who saw it could give the same description.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that the published details alone cannot establish ownership. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 持ち主の確認は事務所で行います。相手には受取先を変更したと伝えられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: The office will confirm the owner. Can you tell the person that the collection point has changed?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。私と会うのでなく、管理事務所へ来てほしいと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 引渡し先を事務所へ変更すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I will ask them to come to the management office instead of meeting me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will change the handover location to the office. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 投稿にも変更を書き、個人の連絡先を広く載せないようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also update the post and avoid publicly sharing personal contact information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 投稿の連絡先は消します。写真を見た人が来たことも、事務所へ伝えておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 公開連絡先を消し来訪予定を引き継ぐ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will remove the contact details from the post. I will also tell the office that someone who saw the photo is coming.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Remove the public contact details and pass on the expected visit. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。拾った場所と時刻も伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. Please also tell me where and when you found it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 花壇の前で三十分ほど前です。受取人の確認をお願いします。私は投稿の案内を直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 発見情報を伝え本人確認を任せる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: In front of the flower bed, about thirty minutes ago. Please check the claimant's identity. I will correct the instructions in my post.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Give the discovery details and leave identity verification to the office. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お預かりしました。相手が来たら事務所で対応します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have taken it into safekeeping. The office will assist the person when they arrive.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 乗場変更のご案内です。表示を確認してご乗車ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is an announcement of a platform change. Please check the display before boarding.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今の放送を聞き取れませんでした。友人には三番へ来るよう、さっき伝えています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 放送を聞き取れず旧乗場を友人へ伝えたと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I could not make out the announcement just now. I told my friend earlier to come to platform three.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you could not make out the announcement and gave your friend the old platform information. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの列車に乗るご予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which train are you planning to take?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 十時発の列車です。友人はまだ駅の外なので、古い案内のまま来るかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 対象の列車と友人の現在位置を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: The ten o'clock train. My friend is still outside the station and might come following the old information.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Specify the train and your friend's current location. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この教材の十時発は二番へ変更されています。駅の表示も二番になっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: The ten o'clock departure in this learning material has changed to platform two. The station display also says platform two.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では友人へ訂正します。三番に集まってから移るより、先に二番へ来てもらった方がよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 合流案内を新乗場へ訂正すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I will correct the information for my friend. It would be better to have them come straight to platform two rather than meet at three and move afterward, wouldn't it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will correct the meeting instructions to the new platform. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 現在の表示を確認しながら移動してください。変更を伝えた返事は来ましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check the current displays as you move. Have you received a reply to your message about the change?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだです。電話が通じない場合は、友人が来る三番で私だけ待ってよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 連絡不能時の待機を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Not yet. If I cannot reach my friend by phone, may I wait by myself at platform three, where they are coming?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Discuss where to wait if you cannot contact your friend. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 安全な位置で待てますが、発車までの移動時間も必要です。乗車に間に合わない時は無理をしないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: You may wait in a safe position, but you also need time to move before departure. If you cannot make the train, please do not take risks.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。変更を伝え、返事がなければ安全な所で合流します。走って乗ることはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 合流と安全な乗車を優先する計画を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will tell my friend about the change, and if there is no reply, we will meet in a safe place. I will not run to board the train.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain a plan that prioritizes meeting up and boarding safely. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 乗場と発車の表示をもう一度確認してお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please check the platform and departure displays once more before proceeding.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 先ほどの相談は担当へ引き継ぎました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: I have passed your earlier inquiry on to the staff member in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今、家族から追加の写真が届きました。別の番号札を取ってもう一度出した方がよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 受付済み相談へ新資料が届いたと知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: My family just sent an additional photo. Should I take another numbered ticket and submit it again?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that new material has arrived for a consultation already registered. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 同じ相談の資料なら、まず担当へ追加として伝えます。内容は何ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: If it concerns the same inquiry, I will first notify the staff member of it as an addition. What does it show?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 先ほど説明できなかった封筒の裏側です。そこに提出先の名前がありました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 封筒裏面の提出先情報だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: The back of the envelope I could not explain earlier. It has the name of the submission destination on it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that it shows the submission destination on the back of the envelope. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では元の相談と合わせて確認します。写真を撮った日や、誰の封筒か分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then we will check it together with the original inquiry. Do you know when the photo was taken and whose envelope it is?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日、母が私宛ての封筒を撮りました。母の申請ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 撮影者と申請者を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: My mother photographed an envelope addressed to me today. It is not my mother's application.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish the photographer from the applicant. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当がまだ資料を確認していない場合もあるので、追加があると連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. The staff member may not yet have checked the materials, so I will notify them that there is an addition.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。先に話した提出先は推測でした。写真の名前と違うので、その説明も直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 以前の推測を資料に基づき訂正したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. The submission destination I mentioned earlier was a guess. It differs from the name in the photo, so I would like to correct that explanation too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to correct your earlier guess based on the document. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 推測の部分を訂正したいことも伝えます。元の番号をこちらで確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will also tell them that you want to correct the part that was a guess. I will check your original number here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この番号です。同じ相談への追加資料と訂正として扱ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 元番号を示し同じ相談へ追記を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: This is the number. Please treat it as additional material and a correction to the same inquiry.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show the original number and ask for an addition to the same inquiry. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当へ連絡しました。別の番号は取らず、この案内でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I have contacted the staff member. Please wait with this information and do not take another number.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 以前の診療資料はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have any records from previous medical care?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 外国語の資料です。翻訳アプリでは怖い病名になりましたが、本当にその意味か分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自動翻訳の病名が不確かだと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: They are in a foreign language. A translation app gave a frightening disease name, but I do not know whether that is really what it means.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Discuss your uncertainty about a disease name produced by automatic translation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 受付で病名を判断することはできません。原文を医療者に確認してもらいましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Reception cannot determine the diagnosis. Let us have a medical professional check the original text.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: では自分で病名を申込書に書き込まず、原文を見せた方がよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 申込書に断定して書く前に扱いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then should I show the original rather than writing the disease name on the application form myself?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask how to handle it before writing a definite disease name on the form. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 翻訳が不確かであると伝えて、原文と訳文を区別してお出しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Say that the translation is uncertain and submit the original and the translation clearly distinguished.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 原文はこの紙、アプリの訳はこの画面です。診断が確定したと自分からは言いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 原文と機械翻訳を区別して提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: The original is this paper, and the app translation is on this screen. I will not state that the diagnosis has been confirmed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Present the original and machine translation separately. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 分かりました。その資料を受け取った経緯も伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. Please also explain how you received those documents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 検査の後に渡された物ですが、結果の説明を全部理解できませんでした。内容を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 資料を受け取った経緯と理解不足を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: They were given to me after a test, but I did not fully understand the explanation of the results. I would like to check what they say.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain how you received the documents and that you did not fully understand. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その点も担当へ伝えます。今の体調については別に教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will tell the staff member that too. Please tell us separately how you are feeling now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は頭が重いです。資料の病名と結び付けず、今の症状として伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 現在症状を病名の推測と分けて伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: My head feels heavy today. I will describe it as a current symptom without linking it to the disease name in the document.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Describe current symptoms separately from guesses about the disease name. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。不確かな訳と現在の症状を分けて引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will pass on the uncertain translation separately from your current symptoms.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: やり取りの経緯を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please tell me how the exchanges unfolded.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今、その相手から電話が来ました。ここで出て、警察に代わってもらった方がよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 相談中に相手から着信したと知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: That person is calling me right now. Should I answer here and pass the phone to the police?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that the other person is calling during the consultation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 急いで応答する必要はありません。まずお客様が安全に話せる状態か確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: There is no need to answer in a hurry. First, let us check whether you are in a position to speak safely.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 出るのは怖いです。今いる場所も相手には知らせたくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 応答への不安と居場所を知らせたくない希望を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I am afraid to answer. I also do not want the person to know where I am now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Express your fear of answering and your wish not to reveal your location. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では応答せず、ご希望を伺います。着信の表示は残っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then let us hear your wishes without answering. Is the incoming call information still displayed?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。記録を消さずに残します。警察が来るように言ったと、私から伝えるのもやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 記録を残し警察の方針を勝手に伝えないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I will keep the record without deleting it. I will also refrain from telling them myself that the police said to come here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will keep the record and not make your own claims about the police's intentions. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの対応が決まる前に、そのような説明はしないでください。今は着信時刻を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please do not give that kind of explanation before we decide how to respond. For now, we will check the time of the incoming call.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。留守番電話が入ったら、その内容も後で確認してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 留守番電話の相談方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. If they leave a voicemail, could you also check its contents later?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask how to discuss a voicemail. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 受信した物があれば、消さずにご相談ください。現在の相談を続けてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you receive anything, please do not delete it and ask us about it. May we continue the current consultation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。電話には出ず、今いる場所を伝えないまま、これまでの経緯を話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 応答せず経緯説明を続けると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will not answer the call or reveal my current location, and I will tell you what has happened so far.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will continue explaining events without answering the call. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。着信があったことも記録します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will also record that there was an incoming call.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの欄に受取の確認をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please confirm receipt in this section.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 字が苦手なので、一緒に来た友人に私の名前を書いてもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 署名を友人へ頼もうとしたと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am not good at writing, so I will ask the friend who came with me to write my name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you were about to ask your friend to sign for you. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どなたが荷物を受け取る方ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私です。友人は荷物を持ってくれるだけで、受取人ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 実際の受取人と同行者の役割を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I am. My friend is only helping carry it and is not the recipient.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain who the actual recipient is and the accompanying person's role. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では記入を手伝ってもらう範囲を確認しましょう。ここは受け取る方の確認欄です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then let us check what kind of help with filling it in is appropriate. This is the section for the recipient's confirmation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 自分で書きますが、欄の見出しを読んでもらってよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 署名代行でなく見出し説明を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will write it myself, but may I have my friend read the section heading to me?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for an explanation of the heading rather than someone signing for you. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 見出しの説明はできます。署名方法が難しければ、先に窓口へご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: The heading can be explained. If you have difficulty with how to sign, please ask the counter first.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 名前は書けます。友人には説明を頼み、私自身が内容を確かめて書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人が理解して記入すると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I can write my name. I will ask my friend to explain, then check the contents and fill it in myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will understand and fill it in yourself. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。記入後は確認用の控えと荷物をお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. After you fill it in, we will give you the confirmation copy and the parcel.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 書きました。受取人は私で、友人の名前ではありません。荷物を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自分の署名と荷物の受取を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have written it. I am the recipient; that is not my friend's name. I will check the parcel.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm your own signature and receipt of the parcel. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認しました。こちらの荷物をお受け取りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I have checked it. Please take this parcel.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご相談の内容を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please tell me what you would like to discuss.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 忘れないようにカードの情報を書いてきました。暗証番号も、この紙にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 相談メモへ暗証番号を書いたと知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I wrote down my card information so I would not forget it. My PIN is also on this paper.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you wrote your PIN in your consultation notes. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 番号は読み上げたり、こちらへ見せたりしないでください。紙はご自身でお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please do not read the number aloud or show it to us. Keep the paper with you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。カードが使えないと説明するのに、番号が必要だと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 番号が必要と思った理由を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. I thought the number was needed to explain that my card was not working.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain why you thought the number was needed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 窓口へ暗証番号を知らせる必要はありません。使えなかった場所と表示を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: You do not need to disclose your PIN at the counter. Please tell us where you were unable to use the card and what the display said.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 昨日ATMで試しました。画面の文言は覚えていますが、番号を口にせず説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 番号を明かさずATMの状況を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I tried at an ATM yesterday. I remember the wording on the screen and will explain without saying the number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain the ATM situation without revealing the number. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お願いします。メモは番号の部分を見せず、状況だけ確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please do. Can we check only the circumstances in your notes without seeing the number?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、紙を折って隠しました。試した回数も三回と書いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 番号を隠し試行回数を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, I folded the paper to hide it. I also wrote that I tried three times.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Hide the number and show how many attempts you made. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 回数と表示をもとに、カードの状況を確認します。いま番号を試し直すのはお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check the card's status based on the number of attempts and the display. Please wait before trying the number again now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 承知しました。番号は伏せたまま、表示と回数を説明して確認を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 再試行せず状況確認を待つと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will keep the number hidden, explain the display and number of attempts, and wait for the check.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will wait for the situation to be checked without trying again. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、ご本人確認からご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then let us begin by verifying your identity.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 取消操作のお手伝いですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you need help canceling an item?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この商品をやめたいです。画面からは消せましたが、袋の中に入れたままです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 取消済み商品が袋に残っていると知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I do not want this item anymore. I removed it from the screen, but it is still in the bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that an item you canceled is still in the bag. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お支払いはまだですね。まず買わない商品を袋から出して分けましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: You have not paid yet, correct? First, let us take the item you are not buying out of the bag and set it aside.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。この一つです。同じ物を二つ読み取ったので、残りの一つは買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二個中一個だけ購入すると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, it is this one. I scanned two identical items, and I will buy the other one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you are buying only one of the two items. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 画面の数量は一つになっています。袋の中にも一つだけ残っているか確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: The quantity on the screen is now one. Please check that only one remains in the bag too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 確認しました。一つだけです。取り消した分は棚へ戻す前に、係員へ渡してよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 袋と画面を照合し取消品を渡したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I checked. There is only one. May I give the canceled item to a staff member before returning it to the shelf?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Compare the bag with the screen and ask to hand over the canceled item. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お預かりします。ほかにも袋へ入れた物で未読取りの物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will take it. Is there anything else in the bag that has not been scanned?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだ袋の底に一つあります。取り消した商品とは別です。今読み取ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 別の未読取り品を申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: There is still one item at the bottom of the bag. It is different from the canceled item. I will scan it now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report another unscanned item. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お願いします。画面の一覧と、袋にある購入品を照合してからお支払いください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please do. Compare the list on the screen with the items you are buying in the bag before paying.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 一覧と数を確認できました。買わない一つを渡して、残りを支払います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 現物と一覧を合わせて会計すると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have checked the list and quantities. I will hand over the one I am not buying and pay for the rest.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will match the actual items to the list and pay. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらをお預かりしました。画面の合計をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: I have taken this item. Please check the total on the screen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: このテントの前は空けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please keep the area in front of this tent clear.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人との写真の集合場所にしました。看板が大きいので分かりやすいと思ったのですが。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 救護テントを集合目印にしたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I made it the meeting place for taking photos with my friends. I thought the large sign would make it easy to find.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you chose the first-aid tent as a meeting landmark. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ここは救護の出入口です。お待ちの方が集まると通りにくくなります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: This is the first-aid entrance and exit. If people gather here to wait, it becomes difficult to pass through.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 救護場所だとは気づきませんでした。友人はあと五人来るので、案内を変更します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未到着人数を示して場所変更を申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I did not realize it was the first-aid area. Five more friends are coming, so I will change the instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say how many people have not arrived yet and offer to change the location. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 掲示の集合スペースをご利用ください。こちらから少し離れています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please use the meeting area shown on the notice. It is a little way from here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: その場所に看板はありますか。写真を一枚送って知らせたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 新集合点の目印を質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Does that place have a sign? I would like to send a photo to let them know.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about a landmark at the new meeting point. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 集合スペースには青い案内があります。救護中の人が写る場所での撮影は避けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: The meeting area has a blue sign. Please avoid taking photos where people receiving first aid would be visible.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。新しい看板だけ撮り、友人へ「こちらへ変更」と送ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 救護利用者を撮らず変更案内を送ると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I will photograph only the new sign and send my friends a message saying, 'We have moved here.'
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will send updated directions without photographing people using first aid. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 荷物も移動してください。救護テントの前へ戻って待たないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please move your belongings too. Do not come back and wait in front of the first-aid tent.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。荷物を持って全員に連絡し、集合スペースで待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 荷物も移し新しい場所で待つと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will take my belongings, contact everyone, and wait in the meeting area.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will move your belongings too and wait at the new location. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご協力ありがとうございます。こちらの通路をお使いください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12233-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for your cooperation. Please use this path.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お荷物が大きいですね。お困りの点はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Your luggage is quite large. Is there anything you need help with?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二人で同じ扉から乗りたいのですが、このケースを置くと友人の通る所が狭くなります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 大型ケースと同行者の動線の問題を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: We would like to board through the same door, but if I put this case down, it narrows the space my friend can pass through.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the problem with the large case and your companion's path. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 通路を塞がない置き方を確認しましょう。ケースを立てたまま固定できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check how to place it without blocking the passage. Can you keep the case upright and secure?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。車輪が動くので、手で押さえる必要があります。乗ってから置く場所を探すのは不安です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 車輪が動き乗車後の探索が不安だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. The wheels move, so I need to hold it by hand. I am worried about searching for a place to put it after boarding.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that the wheels move and you are worried about looking for a space after boarding. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 乗車位置と車内の置場は列車によって違います。対象の列車を確認してからご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: The boarding position and luggage space inside vary by train. We will check your train first and then guide you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この時刻の列車です。二人が離れる場合、私だけ荷物を持っても大丈夫な位置にしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 列車を示し一人でも保持できる位置を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: It is the train at this time. If we have to be apart, I would like a position where I can safely hold the luggage by myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show which train and ask for a position where you can hold the luggage alone. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 係員が案内する位置でご乗車ください。荷物を無人で残して席へ移らないようお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please board at the position the staff member indicates. Do not leave the luggage unattended and move to a seat.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。友人には先に席を取らず、一緒に案内を聞いてもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同行者も案内を聞くよう調整すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I will ask my friend not to go ahead to get seats, but to listen to the instructions with me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will arrange for your companion to hear the instructions too. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その方が確認しやすいです。列車が来るまでは通行の妨げにならない所でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: That will make it easier to confirm. Please wait somewhere that does not obstruct others until the train arrives.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。ケースを押さえて待ち、二人で置き場所の案内を聞いてから乗ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 通路を空け保持しながら待つと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will hold the case while waiting, and we will both listen to the instructions about where to put it before boarding.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will keep the passage clear and wait while holding the case steady. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 対象の列車を確認しますので、こちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please wait here while we check the train you are taking.
